items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1976-02-04
items.q: Joplin is a classical thing taken from Chopin, some things that Chopin has done, that type of two-handed piano.

ctx.x: Louie's stomp down. Louie's, Joplin is a classical thing taken from Chopin, some things that Chopin has done, that type of two-handed piano. Technical, trained piano. That is Joplin. That's ragtime.
But, I mean, where do you see the black influence in Joplin? The way it influence is?
